mods.title: Duplicate Variation Handler
mods.description: DO NOT BUNDLE THIS WITH YOUR MOD! Instead, use it as a (optional) dependency using Polymod's dependency feature as follows:"dependencies": { "duplicateVariationsHandler": ">=0.1.0"}What is this?Duplicate Variations Handler is a V-Slice mod for the latest version of the Funkin' (0.8.4) that solves the issue of multiple mods having the same variation of a song, therefore overriding each other. An example of this issue would be if two or more mods installed had Tutorial Erect, which would result it one mod taking the priority over the other and making its Tutorial Erect inaccessible through regular means.How does it work?Every hot-reload and game init, a module would check if a mod overrides a previously established song and its variation, before storing it. Both variations with the same name and variations with different names but the same occupying space (e.g. "doyliaherect" and "cybikkoerect" would both occupy the erect variation) are detected and stored. After that, trying to access a song with detected duplicate variations would open a menu in which you could select the specific version of the song's variation to play, visualized by albums.What about scripts? Scripts for variations with a different name but the same occupying space would get assigned to their variations properly. However, due to the limitations of the engine, scripts with the same file name and/or class name are left as-is. It's recommended for every mod with commonly done songs (such as the upcoming remixes) to name their scripts and variations uniquely by: Making sure their variation is named differently than the variation it's meant to be a stand-in for (for example: "erect" -> "cybikkoerect" for every Cybikko erect remix) Reflecting the first point to the file name and the class of the song script. You could make the song scripts use a different package instead of changing the song script's class name, which would minimize the chances of another mod overriding it.How about scoring? Scores for "duplicate" variations aren't saved for now, since they could be from renamed variations and it would cause complications.Mobile support?Yes.✅ MODS WITH CONFIRMED COMPATIBILITY ✅ MOD: COMPAT STATUS: SUPPORTED: SUPPORTED VERSION: MOD LINK: Functional Yes 1.2.0 Blake Expansion Functional Yes 0.3.3 DOYLIAH Modpack Functional Yes 1.0 Philly Mix Functional Yes 0.1.0 CYBIKKO: Beneath The Mask

mods.title: FNF: VS LÉA
mods.description: You encounter a young girl while chatting with your girlfriend at your local park. It's been a year and a half since I started this mod. It started out as a fun little project featuring silly mixes of myself, then it became a tribute — something very important to me. I want to thank all the people and friends who helped me along the way. I love y'all ? Today, July 26th, is my deceased mother's birthday. She had a long battle with cancer. She always did the best she could, but the disease just became too strong, and she was in so much pain. It was the most horrible moment of my life. I wanted to finish the tribute in my mod for her — on this day, I wanted to show her this gift I made for her. But while I was still making it, the news arrived: she was gone. I'll always love her, and fight for her. I love you, Happy birthday Mom. <33

mods.description: Welcome to SONIC JAMJAMMIN' NEW WEEKTake on the World's Most Famous Hedgehog in WEEK SONIC, a 3-song original level with songs inspired by the rich soundtracks of Sonic CD, Sonic R,Sonic Adventure, and beyond! Can you keep up?PLAYABLE SONIC CAMPAIGNDr. Eggman's got a new path to world domination-- the POWER of MUSIC! Using his greatest creation, METAL SONIC, the Doctor's taking over the city's musical culture to harness its unlimited musical power. What's worse... is that they're convinced METAL SONIC is the REAL SONIC! But Sonic's not the slacker type. Take back the city's music and clear Sonic's name through intricately crafted 'Sonic Mixes' of FNF's unforgettable soundtrack. Face off against the worst of the worst, bring Metal Sonic's reign to an end, and free the spirit of music in Sonic's campaign.GO FOR PERFECTWhen you're playing as Sonic, simply hitting all the notes won't be enough for those brag-worthy P ranks. On top of beating a song flawlessly, you'll need to style on your enemies with a brand new taunt system. After hitting a combo, you'll be able to chain taunts to the rhythm until your next turn. Pull off a sweet chain, and you'll get crazy bonuses that'll shoot you straight to the top! Every SICK note you hit gets added to your SCORE, so be sure to rack up enough for a massive score bonus at the end. Make a name for yourself on the charts as the most stylish MC alive!
